Name: Hippo's Cliffside Falls Farm - Updated for 1.6
Author: Wildflourmods
Description:
[center][font=Georgia][size=3][img]https://i.imgur.com/nfUW6xU.png[/img][/size][/font][font=Georgia][size=3]

Hippo's maps were some of the first map mods I played with and I absolutely love them. Their work is so creative and I was sad to see they lost a lot of their work on their home tech and decided to retire from modding,but they allowed us (very graciously I might add) to update their mods and adopt them so to speak, so this is their Cliffside Falls Farm Map for 1.6!

You can see the original mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10379]here[/url]﻿ and permissions provided via their profile [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/acearohippo?gameId=1303]here[/url]﻿.

This farm is adorable and super customizable. It REPLACES one of the existing farm maps and you can choose that in the config file. 

Toggle other settings like fences, paved areas, lights, dirt/grass and more! Supports recolors and should be compatible with most mods.

I updated certain things to make it compatible with 1.6 and tweaked just a few tiny items like
giving it the new waterfalls, adding a toggle for the quarry area and adding a minecart.

[b]To install:[/b] simply extract and place in your mods folder.

[b]Note:[/b] there are 2 FTM folders; you should pick and use only ONE. One disables the quarry stone so if you change the quarry to the grass in the config you should use the one that says NO QUARRY.

I highly recommend using Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM) to easily adjust your config from the game's menus.

Happy farming!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/RHabloO.png[/img]﻿

[/size][/font][font=Georgia][size=3]Thank you to Acearohippo for their amazing mods like this one.

Thanks to all my friends who listen to me scope creep myself into these mod ideas.[/size][/font][font=Georgia][size=3]

﻿[/size][/font][font=Georgia][size=3]﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/nY2cWBM.png[/img]

A few folks have asked and I now have a kofi if you feel like you’d like to contribute towards the mods and me and my kitties.

[i][color=#d0e0e3][url=https://ko-fi.com/wildflourmods]Ko-fi.com/wildflourmods[/url][/color][/i]

It's absolutely [u]not required ever[/u] to enjoy my mod which will always be free for all; but I thank each and
every one of you who has donated or will possibly in the future. <3[/size][/font][/center]
